do_not: Ava CFD as future or spot

hypotheses.cost: one-way 2 bps research cost; no leverage
hypotheses.dataset: Derived OI-flow panel from frozen GLBX GC/CL curve. No new Databento bytes.
hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Official contract open interest flow confirms a price rise as new longs, an oi shock of fresh demand, not short covering and not curve slope. Not price momentum.
hypotheses.failure_gate: If FALSIFIED, do not retune OI sign or hold. Next = volume x price rescan at $0.
hypotheses.feature: front_oi_change > 0 and settlement change > 0, lagged to OI knowledge
hypotheses.hypothesis: When official front contract open interest rises with the same-session settlement, new longs are being added. After OI knowledge T+1 21:00Z, next-session front return is positive.
hypotheses.name: NEW_LONGS
hypotheses.target: next-session front open-to-open after OI knowledge_time
hypotheses.validation: pre-registered; leakage; knowledge-time; determinism; lineage; FDR q=0.05; four Xavier

hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Contract open interest decline with a higher settlement is short covering, an oi shock that is not new demand. Fade after knowledge time. Not price momentum.
hypotheses.failure_gate: No hold search. Do not flip covering to continuation as a rescue.
hypotheses.feature: front_oi_change < 0 and settlement change > 0, lagged to OI knowledge
hypotheses.hypothesis: When settlement rises while official front open interest falls, the rise is short covering. After OI knowledge, fade the covering bounce.
hypotheses.name: SHORT_COVER
hypotheses.validation: same gates; not a z_cut search

hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Official contract open interest rising into a lower settlement is an oi shock of new shorts, not a curve inversion. Not price momentum.
hypotheses.failure_gate: If failed, do not replace official OI with COT. Next family is volume x price.
hypotheses.feature: front_oi_change > 0 and settlement change < 0, lagged to OI knowledge
hypotheses.hypothesis: When settlement falls while official front open interest rises, new shorts are being added. After OI knowledge, next-session front return is negative.
hypotheses.name: NEW_SHORTS
